text:
kate: Dropping a tiny iteration for the Request Drilldown quick-actions — thinking to surface Export and a Copy correlation pill directly under the request header (one-click common actions). Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/1768012345.png  Thoughts? :mag:
tom: Inline quick-actions make sense for discovery. A couple backend notes: 1) define scopes: "Export trace (full)" vs "Export request (current spans only)" vs "Export errors (CSV)". 2) CSV export is expensive for big projects — probably should be async with a download link.
emily: UX nits: label the actions clearly (eg "Export trace (.zip)", "Export request (current)", "Export errors (CSV)"). For the Copy correlation pill, show a truncated preview (first 8 + ellipsis) with a keyboard/ARIA focus state that reveals the full id and a small copy affordance. Also show a tiny size estimate or "may be large" hint for export.
javi: Backend ack. We already have /export/trace/{id}?scope=full|request|errors but CSV runs as a job. Recommend starting export client-side as a queued job and surface progress URL. For Copy correlation id, default to copying trace_id only; include span_id only when user clicks "Include span" — avoids breaking existing integrators. Implementation example: try navigator.clipboard.writeText(trace_id) with fallback to a hidden textarea and execCommand.
aria: Accessibility checklist: use aria-label="Copy correlation identifier" (avoid ambiguous "ID"), ensure the pill is a real button with tabindex=0, role="button", and has visible focus ring. When copied, announce via aria-live region: "Correlation identifier copied to clipboard". For the truncated preview, include visually-hidden text describing format ("32 hex characters"). Also verify contrast on the pill text — current mock's light-blue text on off-white fails AA at 12px, bump weight or darker color.
kate: Good calls. Quick design decision proposals: - Keep Export in quick-actions; also duplicate in the kebab menu for parity. - Default copy = trace_id (add small chevron to expand and copy trace_id:span_id). - Export triggers async job with toast + link to downloads panel. I'll update mock to show the truncated pill, expanded state, and an "Export size estimate" tooltip.
emily: Small copy tweak: use the phrase "correlation identifier" in UI copy for accessibility/legal clarity. Tooltip copy: "Copies the trace identifier used to link events across systems".
javi: Dev follow-up: ensure links to logs include the full trace context param (trace_id and optionally span_id). Also add rate-limit for export endpoints to avoid throttle during bulk ops.
deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://redwood.design/previews/1768012345 — feedback open for 48h :calendar:
